## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-305-01` — Migration uses a consistent source, preflights space, switches atomically after validation, and recovers from each injected interruption.
- `AC-305-02` — The exact candidate passes fresh install, legacy upgrade, scale, correctness, sleep/wake, login, export, MCP, a 100,000-event storm, and an accelerated 72-hour-equivalent 864-cycle soak on both packaged architectures.
- `AC-305-03` — Distribution remains blocked unless signature, hardened runtime, notarization, stapling, Gatekeeper, and installed launch are proven.

## Required Evidence
